B:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one complete original transparent-background T-shirt artwork master, never a shirt mockup.
Concept and verbatim copy, reading order:
"I DIDN'T BUY A BOWL."
"I BOUGHT SATURDAY"
"AT GRANDMA'S."
Audience: adult antique/vintage treasure hunters recognizing a secondhand object as a way back to a family memory. Warm, sincere, emotionally restrained, not a joke. No brand name.
Visual family: FRAMED ILLUSTRATED ARTIFACT, a compact collectible old storybook/recipe-card print. Deliberate fine rounded rectangular perimeter with modest decorative corner rules, integrated small upper title and two-line lower caption, all one harmonious print system. Not tarot, not gothic, no stars/flowers/celestial motifs.
Within frame: an original simple mid-century kitchen memory. Clearly adult grandmother and little child stand side by side BEHIND a kitchen counter, their lower bodies naturally occluded by counter; grandmother guiding child's hand as they stir batter in one plain vintage mixing bowl. The bowl has a prominent blank paper secondhand price tag tied to its handleless rim by string, hanging visibly in FRONT of the counter, establishing a newly bought used find. This is a symbolic memory, not literal historic ownership. Preserve a distinct bowl silhouette, simple two rim lines, no branded motifs. One adult, one child, two hands on the spoon, other hands supported naturally. A small rolling pin on counter optional; no extra kitchen clutter or room furniture. Big readable shapes and pared-back storybook engraving, limited hatching, faces simple, avoid photographic shading.
Typography: upper exact "I DIDN'T BUY A BOWL." integrated in a small classic serif title field at top inside frame, not arched. Footer "I BOUGHT SATURDAY" then "AT GRANDMA'S." within frame, with enough negative space around lettering; AT GRANDMA'S slightly stronger, no extra wording. Limited warm cream #F1E3C5 dominant light ink, desaturated sage #91A28A for kitchen/figures, small terracotta #B56E51 accent on bowl. Designed for Pepper dark washed blank. The cloth must show through substantial interior and exterior negative space. Genuinely transparent background, no solid paper rectangle, no shirt, no scene background field, no shadows. No copied artwork. The object, memory, words must be clear at print width around 8.25 inches. Medium portrait aspect ratio approximately width:height 0.9:1, shorter and airier than a tall poster. Keep graphic dominant and avoid tiny narrative details or dense faux distress. Make a beautiful adult keepsake shirt.
